locator.title: Готовитесь к беременности? Узнайте, что нужно учесть
locator.lead: Даем простые советы, как улучшить здоровье, и рассказываем про комплекс Фемибион®

current_heading.text: Принимайте фолиевую кислоту и дополнительные витамины по назначению

nearest_text_before.text: Чтобы не допустить осложнений, на профессиональной консультации могут назначить прием фолатов и других витаминов уже на этапе планирования и подготовки к беременности. Например, эксперт может порекомендовать комплекс Фемибион® 1 [18].

nearest_text_after.text: Фемибион® 1 сочетает в себе фолиевую кислоту и метафолин — активную форму фолатов [18]. Она легче усваивается и подходит даже тем, у кого организм не перерабатывает обычную фолиевую кислоту. Кроме того, в состав комплекса входит все, что может понадобиться организму при подготовке к беременности и на ее ранних сроках [18]:

image_reading: Front-facing Femibion 1 carton on a clean white background, with prominent violet branding and a golden lower panel.
The carton includes a golden pregnant-woman silhouette, a large numeral 1, and printed Russian product information; the text and layout are integral to the pack design.
analysis.article_context: Gallery product image accompanying the recommendation to take folates and additional vitamins as prescribed; it introduces Femibion 1 as support during pregnancy planning and the early weeks.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A calm, reassuring presentation of Femibion 1 as a vitamin-and-folate complex for pregnancy planning and early pregnancy.
structured_intent.primary_action: A soft warm sheen travels across the carton’s existing golden lower panel.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The golden lower panel ends with a subtle settled warm highlight near its lower-right edge.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The product package remains recognizably unchanged and conveys steady, supportive care throughout.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, keep the front-facing carton still. A restrained warm highlight begins on the left side of the existing golden lower panel, travels smoothly along its curved band, and eases to a settled glint near the lower-right by the final frames. The fixed view keeps the brand name, numeral, and printed information continuously clear.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. A soft warm sheen travels slowly across the golden lower wave of the Femibion carton, then settles as a subtle glow near the lower-right edge; the package remains fully legible and unchanged.

models.scene_plan: Use the full five seconds for one calm optical motion: a soft warm reflection gradually crosses the existing amber wave from left to right, slowing naturally as it reaches the lower-right edge. Hold only the settled sheen in the closing moment; the carton remains motionless and readable throughout.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed view of the carton. Let a gentle warm light sweep across the existing golden lower band and resolve into a quiet sheen at its right edge, with all packaging text and graphics unchanged.

models.scene_plan: For the four-second shot, animate only an existing optical accent on the golden lower panel. The glint starts promptly, moves evenly along the curved gold area, and reaches a clearly visible but subtle resting highlight near the lower-right at the end. Keep the camera fixed and every printed element stable.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the product carton. A restrained warm glint glides across the golden lower panel from left to right and finishes as a soft settled highlight on the lower-right, leaving all package printing unchanged.
